audience: companies that keep customer records, projects and sales in the Firmao CRM

useCases.title: Find customers and their contact persons
useCases.text: Search customers by name with filters. Then list the contact persons who are linked to them.

useCases.title: Track tasks, projects and logged time
useCases.text: List tasks with status, priority and responsible users, and the projects they belong to. List the logged work time too.

useCases.title: Review the sales pipeline
useCases.text: List opportunities with their stage and expected close date. Read the offers and orders, and the sales notes.

useCases.title: Look up transactions and payment status
useCases.text: List sales and purchase documents with their dates, amounts and payment status. List products and services with prices and VAT rates.

useCases.title: Add a customer and a sales note
useCases.text: Create a customer record, then add a sales note that records the contact history with that customer.

useCases.title: Create a project and its tasks
useCases.text: Create a project with team members and managers, then create tasks inside it with responsible users.
